search_aliases: Shared Public Way paseo (Dr Maya Angelou Lane, north segment)
summary: Pedestrian paseo on the Shared Public Way north of Exposition Street, between Parcels A (The Canyon) and G (the Visa building). The developer's Phase 1 overview, submitted to the Port in July 2019, lists 'A pedestrian paseo in between Parcels A and G' among the public spaces to be created as part of Phase 1; matching that paseo to the Shared Public Way is Pier & Point's reading (see open questions). In February 2025 Port staff listed 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' among the Phase 1 public improvements put to the Commission for acceptance as Port owned, and a June 2026 Port staff report says 'the City has accepted all public infrastructure, including parks, streets, and public utilities within the Phase', without naming this paseo.

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) lists the Shared Public Way in Figure 3.1.1 as 'Section 4.2 Paseo: Shared Public Way'

Developer's Phase 1 overview, submitted to the Port on this date (it describes a Phase 1 submittal made December 4, 2018 and revised April 24, 2019; the Port's documents date the submittal April 4, 2019), lists 'A pedestrian paseo in between Parcels A and G' among the public spaces to be created as part of Phase 1

Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06 unanimously to accept Phase 1 public infrastructure; staff describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned; the minutes do not name this paseo individually

Port staff report dated June 5, 2026 (for the Commission meeting of June 9, 2026) says the Developer completed Phase 1 in 2025 and 'the City has accepted all public infrastructure, including parks, streets, and public utilities within the Phase'

open_questions: No source read names this paseo on its own as built or accepted. The 'complete' status rests on the Port's general statements that Phase 1 public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G, was accepted (Feb 2025 minutes, June 2026 report); the site was not checked against imagery or a site visit.
Acceptance date and construction cost for this paseo are not published separately in any source read.

The record's identification of the paseo rests on three separate statements: the developer's 2019 Phase 1 overview lists 'A pedestrian paseo in between Parcels A and G' and, separately, says Phase 1 'will also complete the Shared Public Way and Bridgeview Street paseos north of Exposition Street'; no source read says they are the same paseo. The Port's January 2020 street-names report describes the Shared Public Way as 'a future street and future Port open space that will run north-south from China Basin Park to Long Bridge Street' and proposed the name 'Plank Road' for it; Visa's June 2024 post places its building 'on the corner of Toni Stone Crossing and Dr. Maya Angelou Lane', and SF YIMBY (September 2024) says a restaurant in the Visa building faces 'Dr. Maya Angelou Paseo'.

No Port document read says what Exposition Street is called now. The Port's 2020 street-names report proposed 'Spur Street' to replace 'Exposition Street', and the Port's October 2023 report lists 'Approval of new street names honoring Dr. Maya Angelou and Toni Stone', without saying which street took which name. The record name 'Dr Maya Angelou Lane (north segment)' combines DataSF's street-centerline name with Pier & Point's own label for the part north of Exposition Street.
